scientific_limits: F-rich amblygonite and OH-rich montebrasite are distinct current species; G1818/G1871 are description years, not approval accessions.
Groat natural samples and split Li-site models do not demonstrate extraction or a microbial mechanism; near-boundary composition estimates differ among methods.
XN163 Table1 bulk-XRD F=.54 versus EPMAmean.47/range.39-.50, Figure17 .54 versus Figure18legend.45, and4.8(5)wt%lacroixite prohibit unqualified pure-amblygonite thermal attribution.
Shirose thermal experiment10C/min vacuum,10minholds,50-700C;600Cpartial/700Ccompletebreakdown+berlinite are author qualitative assignments, no phase-purity/isolated-yield/Li-Fbalance.
Approach to monoclinic geometry and proposed C2/c precursor/exsolution sequence are interpretation, not recovered phase or experimentally reproduced geological pathway.

Montebrasite patch/vein microtextures and lacroixite-free gem specimen are field/mineralogical observations. Li2O/H2O calculated stoichiometrically. No formation mechanism curated for this identity-only owner.
